about_the_game:
ROLL YOUR DICE!

Kyubu Kyubu Dice is an Action Puzzle Game featuring Teresa-chan, the witch girl. She is responsible of solving the puzzles that roam the "Kyubu Kyubu Island" using her magical necklace known as "Kyubu Kyubu Dice"! With her powers she must uncover the secrets of this mysterious place!

THINK FAST!

Inspired by classic japanese puzzle games, Kyubu Kyubu Dice challenges you to think about objects in different spatially oriented ways, by rolling the "Kyubu" the player must match the side of the their Kyubu with the panels that appear on the stage, but be aware! As the game progresses, the panels spawn faster and faster, it can soon get quite frenetic!

COMBO SYSTEM

With an intricate Combo Chain System skilled players can make the most of their playthroughs making sure that each session never stays the same in this fast-paced puzzle experience.

ARE YOU UP FOR A CHALLENGE?

A challenging new Action Puzzle experience that fans of the genre like yourself can enjoy! Expect A LOT more content! WISHLIST NOW!

  • Graphics: GeForce GTS 750, 1GB or Radeon HD
  • DirectX: Version 11

  • Sound Card: DirectX0.9c
